Name: kelez-bag-sort
Author: zzcfdf
Description: Press and hold **Ctrl** while left-clicking an item to pin it in place. This feature locks item positions in the inventory, helping casual and less dexterous players avoid the hassle of repositioning important items after accidentally pressing the inventory sort button during mining, fishing, and other special scenarios.

Manifest.Name: kelez-xmod
Manifest.Description: Ctrl + Left Click to pin item; prevents accidental sorting.
Manifest.Author: kelez
